<div class="card-body">
'''Assault Rifle''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">アサルト・ライフル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して、戦士キャラクターに配備する。戦闘の際、同じ位置か隣接する位置を射撃できる。戦闘の際に、２フォース使って、起動する。運命数を引く。（運命数＋１）＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中。（運命数＋１）＞回避値か装甲値ならば、ビークルに命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-311o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブラステックＤＬＴ－１９重ブラスター・ライフルは、パワーパックを追加し、射程が延長されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Assault Rifle.

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on a warrior character. During battle it may fire at the same site or an adjacent site. Use 2 Force to fire during battle. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:''' The BlasTech DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle adds extra power packs and extended range.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese fires at the same or an adjacent site; the English fires at a target involved in battle at those sites.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Assault Rifle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
